description: V0.5c stage-d recorded-decision replay: every live LLM run's recorded decisions (docs/benchmark/v05c-dev/stage-d/) submitted again through the protocol by the agent's replay mode, without any model, beside the no-op baseline, under the stage's scenario, seeds, horizon and cadence. Deterministic: a rerun gives the same files. Run from the repository root.
seedPlan: The seeds of docs/benchmark/v05c-dev/stage-d.json, so that the recorded decisions belong to the runs.

external.description: the LLM agent (agents/llm/llm_agent.py, llm-agent 2) in replay mode: qwen36-35b-a3b's recorded decisions from stage-d, one recording per seed, each checked against its decision point and digests, with the memory and prompt rebuilt and checked against their recorded SHA-256; no model is called
